item: fix init.server 2-value return TypeError (a01 out-of-noise list: 'init 2-value')
note: init.server.luau(150,3) TypeError 'Function only returns 1 value, but 2 are required here'. Cause: waveTicks is typed { (number) -> () } (line 64), so pcall(tick, dt) instantiated to (boolean) only, but 'local ok, err' needs 2 values; pcall forwards the callee's return tail, so a void callee leaves no err channel. Minimal fix per Luau rules: wrap the call in an anonymous function with a ...any return tail (house style: ShadowLedger/HeadMuseum/NpcGateway all wrap pcalls). No behavior change on the success path; err still carries the failure message at runtime. mountain_check NOT run (held by t1a this wave).
